issue.title: Broken Javadoc generation with Java 9
issue.body:
In master. Temporary disabled for Java 9.

```
Execution failed for task ':javadoc'.

> Javadoc generation failed. Generated Javadoc options file (useful for troubleshooting): '/home/travis/build/mockito/mockito/build/tmp/javadoc/javadoc.options'
```

Sample Travis build: https://travis-ci.org/mockito/mockito/jobs/179224893#L212

{"number": 787, "label": "bug", "route": "repro-check", "related": [894, 1476, 1595], "evidence": [], "reply": "Thanks for the report. To reproduce this we need a few details:
1. The Mockito version or commit you built from.
2. The JDK version (the output of java -version) and the exact build command you ran.
3. The full javadoc error output, including the lines printed before 'Javadoc generation failed'. The message in the report only points to the options file, so the actual javadoc error is missing.
With these we can check whether the failure still happens on the current source."}
